item.portal_linker.portal_linker.desc: Right-click one empty frame, then the other.
portal_linker.stored: Stored a %s×%s frame. Right-click the second frame.
portal_linker.none_stored: No frame stored. Right-click a frame.
portal_linker.no_frame: That is not an empty frame. Use a rectangle of frame blocks, corners included, interior at least 1×2 and at most %s×%s.
portal_linker.ambiguous: That block is part of more than one opening. Click a different frame block.
portal_linker.mismatch: Those openings don't match. Both interiors have to be the same size, such as 3×5 and 5×3. This linker does not scale.
portal_linker.same: That is the frame you already stored. Right-click the other one.
portal_linker.already: That frame is already linked. Break a frame block to close it.
portal_linker.gone: The stored frame is no longer there. The selection was cleared.
portal_linker.ship: That frame is on a ship. Portal Linker cannot link ship frames yet. Build both frames on the ground.
portal_linker.claim: You can't link that. A frame is in a claim you can't build in.
portal_linker.claim_error: The claim check failed, so the link was refused.
portal_linker.border: That frame is outside the world border.
